instructions.en: Run `bazel clean --expunge` in each workspace, or `bazel shutdown` followed by deleting its output tree.
instructions.nb: Kjør `bazel clean --expunge` i hvert workspace, eller `bazel shutdown` etterfulgt av å slette output-treet.

summary.en: Build outputs and repository caches for every Bazel workspace, kept in /private/var/tmp. A running Bazel server holds locks here.
summary.nb: Byggresultater og repo-cacher for hvert Bazel-workspace, lagret i /private/var/tmp. En kjørende Bazel-server holder låser her.
